name: Soft-Boiled
effect_text: The target regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Points. The user may target themselves with Soft-Boiled.

name: Solar Beam
effect_text: If the weather is not Sunny, the user's turn ends. If the weather is Sunny, immediately proceed to the Resolution Effect instead and this Move loses the Set-Up keyword. The user attacks with Solar Beam. If the weather is Rainy, Sandstorming, or Hailing, Solar Beam's Damage Base is lowered to 6 (2d6+8 / 15).

name: Solar Blade
effect_text: The user attacks with Solar Blade. If the weather is Rainy, Sandstorming, or Hailing, Solar Blade's Damage Base is lowered to 6 (2d6+8 / 15). If the weather is not Sunny, the user gains +1 Combat Stage in Attack and Special Defense, and the user's turn ends. If the weather is Sunny, immediately proceed to the Resolution Effect instead and this Move loses the Set-Up keyword.

name: Sonic Boom
effect_text: Sonic Boom causes the target to lose 15 Hit Points. Sonic Boom is Special and interacts with other moves and effects as such ( Special Evasion may be applied to avoid it, Mirror Coat can reflect it, etc. )

name: Spacial Rend
effect_text: Spacial Rend is a Critical Hit on Even-Numbered Rolls.

name: Spark
effect_text: Spark Paralyzes the target on 15+.

name: Sparkling Aria
effect_text: When you hit a target with Sparkling Aria, the user may choose to deal no damage and instead cure that target of Burn, Confusion, Infatuation, or Rage.

name: Spectral Thief
effect_text: Before rolling damage, transfer all Combat Stages on the target to the user.

name: Speed Swap
effect_text: The user and the target trade Initiative values.

name: Spider Web
effect_text: Spider Web cannot miss. The target is Stuck and Trapped. If the user is freed of the Stuck condition, they are freed of Trapped as well.

name: Spike Cannon
effect_text: None

name: Spikes
effect_text: Set 8 square meters of Spikes within your range, all 8 meters must be adjacent with at least one other space of Spikes. Spikes cause terrain to count as Slow Terrain, and a grounded foe that runs into the hazards will lose a Tick of Hit Points and become Slowed until the end of their next turn.

name: Spiky Shield
effect_text: If the user is hit by an attack, the user may use Spiky Shield. The user is instead not hit by the Move. You do not take any damage nor are you affected by any of the Move's effects. In addition, if the triggering attack was Melee ranged, the attacker loses a Tick of Hit Points.

name: Spirit Break
effect_text: The target's Special Attack stat is lowered 1 CS.

name: Spirit Lance
effect_text: Spirit Lance deals +3 damage to all targets for each target beyond the first that it successfully hits.

name: Spirit Shackle
effect_text: The Target is Trapped for 2 rounds.

name: Spit Up
effect_text: For each Stockpiled Count the user has, Spit Up's Damage Base is increased by +8. If the user has no Stockpiled count, Spit Up cannot be used.

name: Spite
effect_text: Spite may be used as a Free Action that does not take up a Command whenever the user is hit by a Move. That Move becomes Disabled for the attacker.

name: Splash
effect_text: Shift Action - The user may make a single Jump, adding +1 to their Long Jump and High Jump values, and gains +2 Evasion until the end of their next turn.

name: Spore
effect_text: The target falls Asleep.

name: Spotlight
effect_text: Until the end of the user's next turn, the target is Blinded and Vulnerable.

name: Stealth Rock
effect_text: Set 4 square meters of Stealth Rock hazards within 6 meters. If a foe moves within 2 meters of a space occupied by Rocks, move at most one Rock to the offender, then destroy the Rock. When that happens, the Stealth Rock causes a foe to lose a Tick of Hit Points. Stealth Rock is considered to be dealing damage; Apply Weakness and Resistance. Do not apply stats. A Pokémon who has been hit by a Stealth Rock Hazard cannot get hit by another in the same encounter until it is returned to a Poké Ball and then sent back out.

name: Steam Eruption
effect_text: Steam Eruption Burns all Legal Targets on 15+. Steam Eruption may be used even if the user is Frozen, and cures the user and all Legal Targets of the Frozen condition.

name: Steamroller
effect_text: Steamroller Flinches the target on 15+. If the target is Small, Steamroller deals an additional +5 Damage.

name: Steel Beam
effect_text: The user's Hit Points are reduced by 50% of their full Hit Point value. This Hit Point loss cannot be prevented or reduced in any way.

name: Steel Wing
effect_text: Raise the user's Defense 1 Combat Stage on 15+.

name: Sticky Web
effect_text: Set 8 square meters of Sticky Web hazards within your range, all 8 meters must be adjacent with at least one other space of Sticky Web. Sticky Web causes Terrain to become Slow Terrain, and a foe that runs into the hazard has its Speed lowered by one stage, and they become Slowed until the end of their next turn. Flying- type Pokémon and Pokémon and Trainers with Levitate are not affected by Sticky Web. Bug-type Pokémon may move over Sticky Web harmlessly, destroying the Hazards as they do so.

name: Stockpile
effect_text: The user adds 1 to their Stockpiled count to a maximum of 3. For each number a Stockpiled count is above 0, raise the user's Defense 1 Combat Stage and raise the user's Special Defense 1 Combat Stage. If a Stockpiled count is set to 0, the Combat Stages gained from the Stockpiled count are removed.

name: Stomp
effect_text: Stomp Flinches the target on 15+. If the target is at least one size category smaller than the user, Stomp deals an additional 10 damage.

name: Stomping Tantrum
effect_text: If the user's last attack failed or missed, Stomping Tantrum is DB 15 (4d10+10 / 45) instead.

name: Stone Edge
effect_text: Stone Edge is a Critical Hit on 17+.

name: Stored Power
effect_text: For every Combat Stage the user has above 0, add +2 to Stored Power's Damage Base, up to a maximum of Damage Base 20.

name: Storm Throw
effect_text: If Storm Throw hits, it is a Critical Hit.

name: Strange Steam
effect_text: The target is confused on 17+.

name: Strength
effect_text: You may immediately initiate a Push Maneuver as a Free Action. The Maneuver automatically hits, but you must still make the Opposed Roll.

name: Strength Sap
effect_text: The user gains Hit Points equal to the higher of the target's Attack or Special Attack; the target then loses 1 Combat Stage in that Stat.

name: String Shot
effect_text: Targets have their Speed CS lowered by -1. If this lowers their Speed CS to -6, or if their Speed CS was already at -6, the target is instead Stuck.

name: Struggle Bug
effect_text: On hit, lowers the target's Special Attack by -1 CS.

name: Stuff Cheeks
effect_text: The user immediately consumes one of its Food Buffs, regardless of any conditions that need to be met, gaining its benefit if applicable. If a Buff is consumed, the user's Defense CS is raised by 2.

name: Stun Spore
effect_text: The target is Paralyzed.

name: Submission
effect_text: On an accuracy roll of 15+, the target is Tripped.

name: Substitute
effect_text: The user loses 1/4 of their maximum Hit Points. This Hit Point loss cannot be prevented in any way. The user creates an Illusory Substitute Coat, which has Hit Points equal to 1/4th of the user's full Hit Points +1. If the user would be hit by a Move or attack, instead the Substitute gets hit. Apply weakness, resistance and stats to the Substitute. The Substitute is immune to Status Afflictions and Status Moves. Moves with the Social or Sonic keywords completely ignore and bypass the Substitute. Once the Substitute has been destroyed, the user may be hit as normal. Substitute cannot be used if the user has less than 1/4 of their full Hit Points.

name: Sucker Punch
effect_text: If an adjacent foe targets the user with a Damaging Attack, Sucker Punch may be used as an Interrupt Move against the triggering foe.

name: Sunny Day
effect_text: The weather becomes Sunny for 5 rounds. While Sunny, Fire-Type Attacks gain a +5 bonus to Damage Rolls, and Water-Type Attacks suffer a -5 Damage penalty.

name: Sunsteel Strike
effect_text: This Move ignores any Abilities that would cause it to fail or miss, such as Dodge or Wonder Guard; those Abilities cannot be activated in response to Sunsteel Strike.

name: Super Fang
effect_text: The target loses 1/2 of their current Hit Points.

name: Superpower
effect_text: Superpower lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1 Combat Stage each.

name: Supersonic
effect_text: The target becomes Confused. On miss, the target suffers a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for one full round.

name: Surf
effect_text: As a Shift Action, the user may Move to any open square in Surf's area of effect without provoking any Attacks of Opportunity.

name: Swagger
effect_text: The target's Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages. Swagger Confuses the target.

name: Swallow
effect_text: If the user's Stockpiled count is 1, they are healed 25% of their full Hit Point value; if their Stockpiled count is 2, they are healed half of their full Hit Point value; if their Stockpiled count is 3, they are healed back to full Hit Points. After using Swallow, the user's Stockpiled count is set to 0. If the user has no Stockpiled count, Swallow does nothing.

name: Sweeping Strike
effect_text: You may attempt a Trip Maneuver against the target as a free action.

name: Sweet Kiss
effect_text: The target becomes Confused. On miss, the target suffers a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for one full round.

name: Sweet Scent
effect_text: Targets hit by Sweet Scent gain a -2 Penalty to Evasion. (Total Evasion may not be lowered to a negative value. )

name: Swift
effect_text: Swift cannot Miss.

name: Switcheroo
effect_text: The user and the target exchange Held Items or Accessory Slot Items.

name: Swords Dance
effect_text: The user's Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages.

name: Synchronoise
effect_text: Synchronoise can only hit targets that share a type with Synchronoise's user.

name: Synthesis
effect_text: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If it is Sunny, the user gains 2/3 of its full Hit Point value instead. If it is Rainy, Sand Storming or Hailing the user gains 1/4 of their full Hit Point value instead.

name: Tackle
effect_text: The target is pushed 2 Meters.

name: Tail Glow
effect_text: Raise the user's Special Attack 3 Combat Stages.

name: Tail Slap
effect_text: None

name: Tail Whip
effect_text: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

name: Tailwind
effect_text: For the remainder of the encounter, all allied trainers and Pokémon gain +5 to their Initiative. Multiple instances of Tailwind cannot stack.

name: Take Aim
effect_text: Raise the user's Accuracy by +1. If the user per- forms an Weapon Move on their next turn that deals damage, add its Damage Dice Roll an extra time to the damage. Limitations: None

name: Take Down
effect_text: You may perform a Trip Maneuver against the target as a Free Action.

name: Tar Shot
effect_text: The target gains a Coat that is automatically expended upon being hit with a Fire Type attack in order to make them one step more vulnerable to that attack. In addition, the target's Speed is lowered by 1 CS.

name: Taunt
effect_text: The target becomes Enraged.

name: Tearful Look
effect_text: Tearful Look lowers all Legal Targets' Attack and Special Attack 1 Combat Stage.

name: Teatime
effect_text: All participants in the battle may choose to immediately consume one of their Food Buffs, regardless of if the conditions to do so are met.

name: Techno Blast
effect_text: Techno Blast's Type can be any Type while holding the appropriate Drive item or Plate item.

name: Teeter Dance
effect_text: Teeter Dance Confuses all Legal Targets.

name: Telekinesis
effect_text: The target becomes Lifted. While Lifted, they gain the Levitate Ability, are Slowed, and lose all Movement Capabilities except for the Levitate 4 granted by Levitate (reduced to 2 by the Slow condition). While Lifted, the user may not apply any Evasion bonuses to determine whether they are hit by Moves or not. The Lifted target may use a Shift Action to roll 1d20; on a result of 16+, they stop being Lifted.

name: Teleport
effect_text: The user Teleports up to X meters, where X is its Teleporter Capability. Teleport can be used as an Interrupt at any time. Moves that targeted Teleport's user continue through the desired target's space if the Move allows for it as if the user hadn't been there; single target moves simply miss.

name: Thief
effect_text: Thief takes the target's Held Item or Accessory Slot Item and attaches it to Thief's user, if the user is not holding anything.

name: Thousand Arrows
effect_text: When calculating Weakness and Resistance for Thousand Arrows, Flying-Typed targets calculate damage as if Flying was neutral to Ground. Thousand Arrows ignores the Levitate ability. The target is knocked down to ground level, and loses all Sky or Levitate Speeds for 3 turns. During this time, they may be hit by Ground-Type Moves even if normally immune.

name: Thousand Waves
effect_text: Legal Targets are Trapped for 2 rounds.

name: Thrash
effect_text: After damage is dealt, the user becomes Enraged and Confused.

name: Throat Chop
effect_text: The target cannot use Moves with the Sonic keyword for the next two turns.

name: Thunder
effect_text: Thunder Paralyzes its target on 15+. If the target is in Sunny Weather, Thunder's Accuracy Check is 11. If the target is in Rainy Weather, Thunder cannot miss. If the target is airborne as a result of Fly or Sky Drop, Thunder cannot miss.

name: Thunder Fang
effect_text: Thunder Fang Paralyzes or Flinches on 18- 19 during Accuracy Check; flip a coin to determine whether the foe gets Paralyzed or Flinches. On 20 during Accuracy Check, the foe is Paralyzed and Flinched.

name: Thunder Punch
effect_text: Thunder Punch Paralyzes the target on 19+.

name: Thunder Shock
effect_text: Thunder Shock Paralyzes the target on 17+.

name: Thunder Wave
effect_text: Thunder Wave Paralyzes the target. Targets immune to Electric Attacks are immune to Thunder Wave's effects.

name: Thunderbolt
effect_text: Thunderbolt Paralyzes the target on 19+.

name: Tickle
effect_text: Lower the target's Attack 1 Combat Stage and lower the target's Defense 1 Combat Stage.

name: Titanic Slam
effect_text: On Even-Numbered Rolls, the target is Slowed for one full round.

name: Topsy-Turvy
effect_text: The target's Combat Stages are inverted; +1 Stage becomes -1 Stage, -3 Stages becomes +3 Stages, etc.

name: Torment
effect_text: The target becomes Suppressed.

name: Touch of Fatigue
effect_text: Touch of Fatigue Slows the target for one full round on 15+.

name: Toxic
effect_text: The target is Badly Poisoned. If the user is Poison Type, Toxic cannot miss.

name: Toxic Spikes
effect_text: Set 8 square meters of Toxic Spikes, all 8 meters must be adjacent with at least one other space of Toxic Spikes next to each other. Toxic Spikes cause Terrain to become Slow Terrain, and a grounded foe that runs into the hazard becomes Poisoned, and Slowed until the end of their next turn. If there are 2 Layers of Toxic Spikes on the same space, it Deadly Poisons the foes instead. Poison-Type Pokémon may move over Toxic Spikes harmlessly, destroying the Hazards as they do so.

name: Toxic Thread
effect_text: The target is Poisoned and has their Speed lowered by 1 Combat Stage. If the target is already Poisoned, they instead lose a Tick of Hit Points and has their Speed lowered by 2 Combat Stages.

name: Transform
effect_text: The user targets a Pokémon within 10 meters, and assumes the form of the target. It gains all of the user's Moves, gains its Abilities, copies its weight and height and Capabilities. Transform lasts until the user is switched out, KO'd or until the end of the encounter. The user may choose to end the Transformation on its turn as a free action, regaining its previous Move List. The user's Stats do not change from using Transform. Transform cannot miss.

name: Tri Attack
effect_text: Tri Attack gives the target a Status ailment on 17+ during Accuracy Check. If this effect is triggered, roll 1d3; on 1 the target is Paralyzed; on 2 the target is Burned; on 3 the target is Frozen.

name: Trick
effect_text: Both targets must be hit for Trick to succeed. The user may target itself or willing allies with Trick; you do not need to roll for Accuracy Check in these cases. Both targets lose their Held Item or Accessory Slot Item, and gain the other target's Held Item or Accessory Slot Item. If a target has no Item, it still can gain the other target's Item.

name: Trick Room
effect_text: Starting at the beginning of the next round, for 5 rounds, the area is considered Rewinding. While Rewinding, Initiative is reversed, and participants instead go from lowest Initiative to Highest.

name: Trick-or-Treat
effect_text: The target gains the Ghost Type in addition to its other Types for 5 turns.

name: Triple Kick
effect_text: Make three attacks with Triple Kick. If you hit once, Triple Kick has a DB of 1. If you hit two times, Triple Kick has a DB of 3. If you hit three times, Triple Kick has a DB of 6.

name: Triple Threat
effect_text: None

name: Trop Kick
effect_text: The target receives a -5 penalty to damage rolls for 1 round.

name: Trump Card
effect_text: Whenever Trump Card is used, the user gains a Trump Count after the attack is resolved. Trump Card's Damage Base is increased by +2 for each Trump Count.

name: Twineedle
effect_text: Twineedle Poisons the target on an Accuracy Check of 18+

name: Twister
effect_text: Small or Medium targets in the central square of the blast are not hit. Twister Flinches the target on 18-20 during Accuracy Check. Any Pokémon Airborne as a result of Fly or Sky Drop above the Blast are hit, ignoring range, and Twister has a Damage Base of 8 against those targets instead.

name: U-Turn
effect_text: If U-Turn successfully hits its target, the user deals damage and then immediately is returned to its Poké Ball in the same turn. A New Pokémon may immediately be sent out. Using U-Turn lets a Trapped user be recalled.

name: Uproar
effect_text: All Pokémon and Trainers within 5 meters of the user are cured of sleep.

name: V-Create
effect_text: Lower the user's Defense, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 CS each.

name: Vacuum Wave
effect_text: None

name: Venom Drench
effect_text: All Poisoned targets have their Attack, Special Attack, and Speed lowered by 1 Combat Stage. Venom Drench cannot miss.

name: Venoshock
effect_text: If the target is Poisoned, Venoshock has a Damage Base of 13 (4d10+10 / 35) instead.

name: Vice Grip
effect_text: None

name: Vine Whip
effect_text: None

name: Vital Throw
effect_text: If the user is targeted by a Melee attack and has not yet taken a turn this round, the user may declare Vital Throw. After the triggering attack is resolved, the user may use Vital Throw against the triggering foe as a Reaction. Vital Throw cannot miss.

name: Volt Switch
effect_text: If Volt Switch successfully hits its target, the user deals damage and then immediately is returned to its Poké Ball in the same turn. A New Pokémon may immediately be sent out. Using Volt Switch lets a Trapped user be recalled.

name: Volt Tackle
effect_text: Volt Tackle Paralyzes the target on 19+.

name: Wake-Up Slap
effect_text: If the target is Asleep, Wake-Up Slap has a Damage Base of 10 (3d8+10 / 24) instead, and cures the target of Sleep.

name: Water Gun
effect_text: None

name: Water Pledge
effect_text: If an ally uses Fire Pledge or Grass Pledge, you may use Water Pledge as Priority (Advanced) immediately after their turn to target the same foe. If used in conjunction with Fire Pledge, a Rainbow is created that lasts for 5 rounds. If used in conjunction with Grass Pledge, the target and all foes adjacent to the target are slowed and have their Speed reduced by 2 Combat Stages. Consult the Pledge keyword for additional details.

name: Water Pulse
effect_text: Water Pulse Confuses the target on 17+.

name: Water Sport
effect_text: All targets in the burst, including the user, gain a Coat which grants them 1 Step of Resistance to Fire Type Moves. After a target has been hit by a damaging Fire Type Move, the coat is removed.

name: Water Spout
effect_text: For each 10% of HP the user is missing, Water Spout's Damage Base is reduced by 1. Water Spout creates a 1 meter burst, but also affects an area 10 meters tall straight up.

name: Waterfall
effect_text: Waterfall Flinches the target on 17+.

name: Wear Down
effect_text: Wear Down lowers the target's Defense by 1 Combat Stage on Even-Numbered Rolls.

name: Weather Ball
effect_text: If it is Sunny, Weather Ball is Fire-Type. If it is Rainy, Weather Ball is Water-Type. If it is Hailing, Weather Ball is Ice-Type. If it is Sandstorming, Weather Ball is Rock-Type. When a weather effect is on the field, Weather Ball has a Damage Base of 10 (3d8+10 / 24). If there are multiple Weather Effects on the field, choose one type for Weather Ball to be that corresponds with an existing Weather Effect.

name: Whirlpool
effect_text: The target is put in a Vortex.

name: Whirlwind
effect_text: All targets are pushed X meters, where X is 8 minus their weight class. If the Line targets into a Smokescreen, the smoke is dispersed. All hazards in the Whirlwind are destroyed.

name: Wide Guard
effect_text: If an Ally adjacent to Wide Guard's user is hit by a Move, you may use Wide Guard as an Interrupt. All targets adjacent to Wide Guard's user, including the user, are instead not hit by the triggering Move and do not suffer any of its effects.

name: Wild Charge
effect_text: None.

name: Will-O-Wisp
effect_text: The target is Burned.

name: Wing Attack
effect_text: None.

name: Wish
effect_text: At the end of the user's next turn, the target regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If the user targets themselves and are replaced in battle, the replacement is healed.

name: Withdraw
effect_text: The user's Defense is raised 1 Combat Stage.

name: Wonder Room
effect_text: For 5 rounds, the area is considered Wondered. While Wondered, each individual Pokémon's Defense and Special Defense Stats are switched.

name: Wood Hammer
effect_text: None

name: Work Up
effect_text: Raise the user's Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user's Special Attack 1 Combat Stage.

name: Worry Seed
effect_text: You choose one of the target's Abilities. Worry Seed changes that Ability to Insomnia for the remainder of the encounter.

name: Wounding Strike
effect_text: The target loses a Tick of Hit Points.

name: Wrap
effect_text: The user gains a +1 Bonus to Accuracy Rolls made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers, and +2 to Skill Checks made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers or gain Dominance. Whenever the user gains Dominance in a Grapple, the target of the Grapple loses a Tick of Hit Points.

name: Wring Out
effect_text: For every 10% the target is below their full Hit Points, Wring Out's Damage Base is reduced by 1.

name: X-Scissor
effect_text: None

name: Yawn
effect_text: The target falls Asleep at the end of their next turn. Yawn cannot miss.

name: Zap Cannon
effect_text: Zap Cannon Paralyzes the target. Zap Cannon ignores the target's Evasion if there are no other combatants or Rough or Blocking Terrain within 2 meters of the target.

name: Zen Headbutt
effect_text: Zen Headbutt Flinches the target on 15+.

name: Zing Zap
effect_text: Zing Zap Flinches the target on 15+.
